title: rulekit patient facts
description: The flat, provenance-free shape the evaluator actually consumes: one patient, a bag of fact values. Files in `fixtures/patients/` and `corpus/patients/` are written directly in this shape; `corpus/facts/*.yaml` (see facts-file.schema.json) is compiled down to it by keeping the pipeline and confirmed entries only.

facts.description: Keyed by fact name. A name absent here is not false — it is `unknown`, and the evaluator says so.

codeEntry.description: One coded row: a diagnosis, a prescription. `daysAgo` is what `anyWithin` measures against; omitting it makes every temporal criterion over this row evaluate `unknown`.
